key_insight: FokasNets use the Fokas method’s Global Relation to supply missing boundary data during physics-informed learning, improving PDE solution accuracy and training efficiency.
engineering_relevance: The framework could improve mixed-boundary PDE simulations and solution operators when accurate boundary behavior is critical.
method: Use lifted neural representations that enforce Dirichlet boundary conditions by construction.
Solve the Global Relation during training to provide missing boundary conditions.
Apply the framework to elliptic and evolution PDEs through Fokas-PINNs and Fokas Operator Networks.
evidence_signal: Experiments with manufactured solutions and literature benchmarks report accuracy gains over standard and lifted PINNs and physics-informed DeepONets, reaching multiple orders of magnitude for solution operators.
watch_item: Implementation requires an appropriate Global Relation formulation and an additional solve during training, whose computational overhead is not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: FokasNets: Completing missing boundary data in Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Operators via the Global Relation
